audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was given to Graves though whys[0] says 'Level 1 is even'; Level 2 was 'Skill' though the level-2/3 whys describe your window; Level 6 was Graves though whys[4] calls it a coinflip; first item was Irelia though whys[5] says his lethality item is his peak and to play for picks instead of trades.
audit.why: Quickdraw only arrives at 3 and Flawless Duet answers it; at 6 Smoke Screen's nearsight and Collateral Damage cancel out Vanguard's Edge; a first-item lethality Graves genuinely kites the dash.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 4 and 5 set to Skill, Irelia, Skill, Graves in both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings — the chart the mirror already applied.

audit.why: Spikes cover level 3 (Flawless Duet), levels 4-5 (Ionian Fervor ramp), level 6 (Vanguard's Edge vs Collateral Damage) and his lethality first item; all four present and correctly timed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields claim Ionian Fervor shreds Graves's armour. Riot's passive text says only that spell hits stack bonus attack speed and that max stacks add bonus damage on hit — no shred, no armour reduction. Separately, the page tells you to track Quickdraw on a clock, but Riot's E text says hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers its cooldown and refreshes the resistance boost.
audit.why: Telling a player their DPS strips his armour while he is stacking True Grit resistances inverts the actual trade maths, and a Quickdraw timer counted on the clock will be wrong every time he lands autos.
audit.corrected: whys[2], spikes[1] and wants.you[0] now describe the attack-speed stacking and four-stack on-hit; Key Ability Interactions now says his autos lower Quickdraw's cooldown so you count his hits, not the clock.

edits.before: Your Ionian Fervor passive comes online and shreds his armor the longer you stick, so chain Q-resets and don't let him kite the trade.
edits.after: Ionian Fervor stacks attack speed as you land spells and adds bonus on-hit at four stacks, so chain Q-resets and never let him kite off.

edits.before: Your Ionian Fervor passive comes online: max-stack autos add on-hit magic damage and shred his armor the longer you stick, so chain Q-resets off the wave and don't let him peel off.
edits.after: Your Ionian Fervor passive comes online: each spell hit stacks attack speed and four stacks add bonus on-hit damage, so chain Q-resets off the wave and don't let him peel off.

edits.before: E-stun the instant his Quickdraw (E) dash is on cooldown, then Q-reset in and let your passive shred his armor
edits.after: E-stun the instant his Quickdraw dash is on cooldown — 16s at rank 1 — then Q-reset in and ramp Ionian Fervor

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — E-stun, Q-reset through the wave.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 but his autos lower it, so count his hits, not the clock — E-stun the moment the dash is spent.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His autos refresh True Grit's resists and cut Quickdraw's timer.

notes: The packet defect flags wants.you[2] 'Use Vanguard's Edge' as a probable wrong ability name — that is a false positive, Vanguard's Edge is Irelia's real R and the line is correct as written. Also worth knowing: Graves's basic attacks fire four bullets that cannot pass through units, so standing behind your own minions genuinely cuts his auto damage; that is not stated anywhere on the page and no field had room for it.
